subject: Re: ACME Health - Pilot credits & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Health - Pilot credits & burn-rate follow-up

Hi Tom / Lena,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from my side:

- Goal: validate ACME's live summarization flow running across 2 models (short-form and long-form) and measure end-to-end latency + token economics.
- Immediate ask from us: estimated monthly token volume, expected production QPS during pilot, and target $/1M tokens that would make a dedicated deployment viable for you.
- Pilot credits: you mentioned you were running into credit constraints by the end of week 2. If you can share current burn rate (tokens/day) and how long you'd like to extend the pilot, we can review to approve additional credits.

From today's call notes:
- Primary workload: ingestion -> summarization (avg input length 1.5k tokens, output 250 tokens)
- Expected pilot traffic: ~500k-800k tokens/day this month (scale to 4-5M tokens/day in production target)
- Initial budget range you mentioned: $6k-$15k/mo (still TBD)

Next steps / requested items by EOD tomorrow if possible:
1) Current 7-day avg token burn and expected burn over next 30 days
2) Preferred pilot extension length (30/60 days) and any internal budget target for a 30-day run
3) Any constraints on model variant (we can route to quantized variant to reduce unit cost)

I've looped in Vivek (sales lead) and Monica (CS) so we can fast-track credit approvals and a brief playbook for rollout. Once I have your burn numbers I'll propose a credits extension and schedule a 2-week check-in.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0143

[Attachment: pilot-readme.txt (text)]

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health - Pilot credits & burn-rate follow-up

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap. Confirming numbers from our side (we ran a short usage export attached):

- Current 7-day avg burn: ~560k tokens/day (summarize short + long combined)
- Expected next 30 days: ~12-18M tokens (conservative 12M, hopeful 18M as we broaden user base)
- Production target (Q3): ramp to ~120M tokens/month across teams
- Target unit economics: we're aiming for ~$7-$9 per 1M tokens as our internal threshold to justify dedicated capacity (includes inference + infra ops)
- Preferred extension: 30 days to fully validate integrations and run the scripted prompts at scale

We'd appreciate a credits top-up to avoid throttling while we finish the integration tests. Also attached is a short CSV (acme-usage-summary.csv) with per-test-case token counts.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Head of Search & Personalization | ACME Health
tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com
(617) 555-0202

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health - Pilot credits & burn-rate follow-up

Tom,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for the CSV — that's super helpful. Based on the 12-18M tokens guidance and your $7-$9 target /1M, I've approved an initial pilot credit top-up and a short operational plan:

- Credits approved: $5,000 in free credits applied to ACME account (visible in Console within 1 hour). This covers approximately ~700k-800k additional tokens/day at the quantized model unit price and should get you through the 30-day extension.
- Extension length: 30 days (we'll re-evaluate at the check-in)
- Burn-rate check-in: schedule 2-week sync (30 mins) on Mon, May 3rd to review usage, latency, and cost. Monica will prep a short playbook and runbook for throttling and caching knobs.
- Routing: we'll default to the quantized variant of the summarization model for the pilot to improve unit economics; if you need the higher-fidelity variant we can auto-fallback for specific test cohorts.

Action items for ACME: please confirm you want the $5k credit applied and whether the 30-day window starting today works (I'll timestamp the grant on activation). Also confirm if you want Monica to join a pre-check on Friday to review telemetry dashboards.

I've attached the formal approval stub for your records.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: pilot-credits-approval.pdf (PDF)]

Confirmed, thank you. Please apply the $5k credit starting today. 30-day window works for us and Monica joining the pre-check on Friday would be great.
